description: Read a scheduled webhook: its status, attempts and, after it fired, the HTTP status and an excerpt of the answer. wait_seconds, up to 25, waits for the status to change before answering. No API key, no account and no sign up.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds, 0 to 25, for the status to change before answering.

name: read_webhook_schedule
title: Read a scheduled webhook
